extensionDescription.message: Translate selected text or full pages with OpenAI-compatible APIs or the Built-in Translator API.

translationOnlyDescription.message: Replace original page text with the translation.

bilingualDescription.message: Keep the original text and show the translation beside it.

visiblePageDescription.message: Translate visible page text collected from the current document.

viewportDescription.message: Translate text near the current viewport as you browse.

visiblePageTranslationEnabled.message: Page translation will use visible page text

viewportTranslationEnabled.message: Page translation will use viewport text only

settingsSynced.message: Settings sync with your browser account

keepOneProfile.message: Keep at least one API profile

cacheDescription.message: Cached translations reduce repeated requests for text translated with the same settings.

translationSettingsDescription.message: Control page translation display, scope, mode, and basic filtering.

textNodeTranslationModeDescription.message: Translate individual text nodes; safer for dense UI but less contextual.

wholeParagraphTranslationModeDescription.message: Translate paragraph-like content with surrounding inline context.

minTranslationTextLengthInvalid.message: Minimum text length must be an integer from 1 to 100

rulesDescription.message: Configure text and node-level rules. Matches stay original and are not sent for translation.

userWhitelistPlaceholder.message: Use English commas, for example: OpenAI, GitHub, API

userWhitelistItemTooLong.message: A whitelist item must be 160 characters or fewer

userWhitelistTooMany.message: The whitelist can store at most 200 items

noTranslateSelectorsPlaceholder.message: Use English commas, for example: pre, code, .notranslate, [data-no-translate]

noTranslateSelectorTooLong.message: A node selector must be 200 characters or fewer

noTranslateSelectorsTooMany.message: The selector list can store at most 100 items

profileNameTooLong.message: Profile name must be $LIMIT$ characters or fewer

profileNamePlaceholder.message: For example: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Internal Model

builtInTranslatorDescription.message: Use the browser built-in Translator API. This mode does not require an API base URL, model name, or API Key, but requires the current browser to support the relevant language pack.

builtInTranslatorFirstUseNotice.message: First use may be slower while language support loads.

apiBaseUrlRequired.message: Please enter an API base URL

apiBaseUrlTooLong.message: API base URL must be $LIMIT$ characters or fewer

modelNameTooLong.message: Model name must be $LIMIT$ characters or fewer

apiKeyTooLong.message: API Key must be $LIMIT$ characters or fewer

customPromptTooLong.message: Custom system prompt must be $LIMIT$ characters or fewer

customPromptPlaceholder.message: Leave blank to use the default translation prompt

translationConcurrencyInvalid.message: Translation concurrency must be an integer from 1 to 8

translationBatchSegmentsInvalid.message: Max segments per request must be an integer from 1 to 8

translationBatchTextLengthInvalid.message: Max text length per request must be an integer from 1 to 4000

pageTextNotFound.message: No visible translatable text found on this page

emptyTranslationResponse.message: The API did not return a usable translation

builtInAiUnavailable.message: The browser built-in Translator API is not available. Enable the built-in translation capability and make sure the current browser supports the relevant language pack.

builtInAiUnsupportedLanguagePair.message: The browser built-in Translator API does not support this language pair.

builtInAiRunsInPage.message: The browser built-in Translator API must run in the page context

missingApiBaseUrl.message: Please enter an API base URL in Options first

missingModel.message: Please enter a model name in Options first

missingApiKey.message: Please enter an API Key in Options first
